nodes.name: Node 1- Flo Labs HR Gmail Trigger

conditions.rightValue: Subject: New submission for your "Websites & Presentations" form

parameters.text:
=Review these Q/A items and summarize the answer quality:
{{$json.qa_json}}

options.systemMessage:
You are a strict reviewer. Output ONLY valid JSON. No prose, no markdown.

Input is a JSON array of objects:
{ "q": string, "a": string }

Write a short overall summary of the answer quality.
Mention if answers look too short, generic, repetitive, copied, or unrelated.

Return exactly:
{
  "summary": string
}

Do not return passCount.
Do not return failCount.
Do not invent item counts.

nodes.name: Node 9- If Any Failed Answers (Connected Email)

parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $('Node 10- fetch the applicant').item.json.first_name }},

Thank you for submitting your answers and completing the form!​

We are pleased to inform you that you have been accepted into our internship. There are just a few remaining steps to complete before signing the agreement and officially beginning. These steps are designed to help you better understand our workflow, culture, and ongoing projects before you’re fully onboarded. I'm pasting below the information on the next steps.

We would like to inform you that the internship position is unpaid but there are paid opportunities after it is completed for those who join our apprenticeship program. Future plans are to offer stock options allowing team members to be shareholders having a stake in the company. That said, we offer a commission-based compensation structure for successful lead generation that results in a sale of our products and services. These include our AI Travel Planner, Robots, and Educational Platform. Additionally, we are launching an innovative franchise network to promote our products through a Robot Dealership model, which will also be available to our interns as an exciting opportunity for growth and collaboration.

We recently had an All Team Meeting where approximately 60 FloLabs Team Members joined and many including Team Leads presented project updates. Next steps please watch the recording below as the meeting will make it clear if you want to join our journey.

https://us06web.zoom.us/rec/play/awsl67M_qYZth0lW2CSw7Gf7KdsU7pEs4uXQcV-Ynw_ijrkbYUa3I7EZnM0_KOTIrLPoupVqbKruFd57.4emkTDHfwF0DIUVH?autoplay=true&startTime=1769363553000

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━──────────────────────────────

Next Step:

Before we proceed to the orientation session with John Hazlewood, our founder, we kindly ask you to watch some of our recent team meetings. These recordings feature student interns providing status updates and introductions, giving you a better understanding of our team dynamics and ongoing projects. We do not want to waste your time in John's group presentation so we would like to kindly ask you to review the recordings provided below. Please share your thoughts by completing the form:

Watch Team Meetings: https://flolabsinnovations.fillout.com/t/wqyLXfXzWGus/a>

Furthermore, we are thrilled to announce our partnership with Unitree Robotics https://www.unitree.com/! We are integrating the Flo Brain into Unitree's Robodog and humanoid robots, expanding our product lineup. This collaboration marks a significant advancement in our robotics initiatives and offers exciting opportunities for our interns.

You can check out our FIRST Robodog here: Flo Labs's RoboDog

Lastly, please note that John is based in Austin, Texas and will host a Zoom group meeting on Saturday at 10AM Central Time. Can you please confirm if you'd be available to join the session?

We look forward to hearing from you! If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to reach out.

Sincerely,
HR Team
FloLabs Innovations Group
